text:
noah: Quick internal heads-up: Finance is publishing a "Usage Safety" and invoice layout update. Enforcement planned 2026-09-01. Purpose: make invoices easier to parse and protect free/trial tiers from runaway consumption. Short summary below.

anita: Can you drop the concrete thresholds? Product needs to update the Console messaging.

noah: Sure 12; high level: free-tier monthly safety cap = 250,000 tokens; advisory notices at 60% and 90% of the cap. If an account crosses 120% of cap we apply a short cooling period (48 hours of reduced throughput) before any hard stop. Educational and nonprofit partners can request a "safety-cap-override" with validation.

leo: How does this differ from current soft quota? Any header changes or client-visible behaviors we should avoid breaking?

noah: No breaking changes. We'll add two headers: `x-usage-safety-remaining` and `x-invoice-preview-id`. 429 semantics unchanged, but we will emit advisory 429s at 90% with `x-advisory=true`. Billing will send a consolidated invoice with a new line item called `peak_usage_surcharge` for sustained overages (>7 days) to help customers understand tail usage.

billing-helper: Note: invoice preview run scheduled 2026-09-02T05:00Z for impacted accounts.

ops: Engineering request: need a boolean field `safety_cap_exempt` for partner accounts and an event `usage_safety_violation`. Also plan a migration to recalc `monthly_safety_snapshots` for the last 60 days.

support-lead: Support asks for an in-Console banner when an account hits 60% and a one-click prepay flow that lets customers buy 100k token bundles at the current PAYG rate. Also create a canned response for advisors.

anita: Product will add the banner + a modal that explains the cooling period and the override request flow. Also will change signup copy to clarify the safety cap.

noah: Communications plan: internal 2026-08-10 -> early access email to high-usage customers 2026-08-17 -> public help article & FAQ 2026-08-24 -> enforcement 2026-09-01. We'll include a CSV attachment for top 10k impacted customers in the targeted email.

leo: Any accounting impact? Finance expects a small bump in upgrade conversions; they also want `peak_usage_surcharge` revenue routed to the platform ops ledger for the first 6 months so we can analyze.

support-lead: Also request a debug panel flag `safety_cap_history` for support agents and a playbook for cooling period appeals. We'll need training slides for the first support wave.

noah: Agreed. Legal: please review the TOS blurb for the cooling period and surcharge language. We'll include an explicit opt-in checkbox for any auto-billing prepay flows.

ops: We'll open infra tickets today for header rollout, migration, and the billing preview job. Staging dry-run the week of 2026-08-18.

noah: Thanks all 14. If no further questions, we'll lock the public copy on 2026-08-24 and tag the cross-functional owners in the rollout doc.
